directedInspection.scope: Rollback de aplicación, configuración y base de datos cuando sea viable, limitado a Desarrollo
outOfScope: provider/productive writes no autorizados expresamente por la autoridad vigente

configurationRollback.strategy: Capture identifiers/state only; never copy secret values. Any provider configuration mutation requires a later dependency-valid scope plus fresh authorization under VAEP_AUTHORITY.
configurationRollback.rollbackControl: restore exact prior known-good provider/deployment/config state and verify health/readback; fail closed if surface cannot safely restore

databaseRollback.isolation: Disposable MySQL restore target; productionTouched=false; non-disposable target is fail-closed

risks: failure to restore CURRENT after rollback
controls: known-good target must be demonstrated before mutation
health/readiness on both rollback and forward-recovery legs
DB restore only into disposable isolated target unless fresh explicit authorization says otherwise
acceptanceCriteria: rollback strategy exists for app/config/DB where viable
causal proof sources are current or equivalence-demonstrated
no large implementation or provider mutation is performed in PRE

exactHeadOrEquivalence.note: PRE introduces no product implementation change; inspected runbook/workflow/receipts are read from current Desarrollo at baseHead. Historical receipts are support only, not automatic closure.
